sentences.zh: 蔣文慶正月甲戌被害。周天爵署。二月丁丑李嘉瑞安徽巡撫。九月辛酉革。江忠源代。劉鉁暫署。十二月甲午忠源殉。福濟補。

translations.literal: Jiang Wenqing was killed on jiaxu in the first month. Zhou Tianjue acted. On dingchou in the second month, Li Jiarui became Governor of Anhui. On xinyou in the ninth month he was dismissed; Jiang Zhongyuan replaced him. Liu Zhen temporarily acted. On jiawu in the twelfth month, Zhongyuan died in service, and Fuji filled the vacancy.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Wenqing was killed on jiaxu in the first month. Zhou Tianjue acted, Li Jiarui became Governor of Anhui on dingchou in the second month, Jiang Zhongyuan later replaced him, Liu Zhen temporarily acted, and after Zhongyuan died in service on jiawu in the twelfth month, Fuji filled the post.

sentences.zh: 崇綸二月甲午憂。青麐湖北巡撫。六月癸未正法。楊霈代。九月辛未遷。曾國藩署。丙子陶恩培補。楊霈兼署。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day of the second month, 崇綸 went into mourning. 青麐 became governor of Hubei. On the guiwei day of the sixth month, he was executed according to law, and 楊霈 replaced him. On the xinwei day of the ninth month, 楊霈 was transferred, and 曾國藩 acted in the post. On the bingzi day, 陶恩培 was appointed to fill the vacancy. 楊霈 concurrently acted in the post.

sentences.zh: 丁寶銓五月病免。陳寶琛山西巡撫。六月留京。陸鍾琦任。九月民軍據太原，死之。吳祿貞署。尋被戕。張錫鑾代。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Ding Baoquan was relieved due to illness. Chen Baochen became Governor of Shanxi. In the sixth month, Chen remained in the capital, and Lu Zhongqi was appointed. In the ninth month, when the revolutionary army occupied Taiyuan, Lu died for the post. Wu Luzhen acted in the post, but was soon murdered. Zhang Xiluan replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Baoquan was relieved due to illness in the fifth month, and Chen Baochen became Governor of Shanxi. In the sixth month Chen remained in the capital, and Lu Zhongqi was appointed. When revolutionary forces occupied Taiyuan in the ninth month, Lu died at his post. Wu Luzhen then acted as governor but was soon murdered, and Zhang Xiluan replaced him.

sentences.zh: 恩壽閏六月病免。余誠格陝西巡撫。錢能訓護。改楊文鼎，未任。九月民軍據西安，能訓被執。升允署。

translations.literal: In the intercalary sixth month, Enshou was relieved due to illness. Yu Chengge became Governor of Shaanxi. Qian Nengxun acted in the post. The appointment was changed to Yang Wending, but he did not take office. In the ninth month, the revolutionary army occupied Xi'an, and Nengxun was captured. Shengyun acted in the post.

When revolutionary forces occupied Xi'an in the ninth month, Qian Nengxun was captured, and Shengyun acted as governor.
